ParticleOffset.Description: The offset of any spawned particle systems.

PostureParticleOffset.Description: Bold: offset of the posture particle from the Head bone, in blocks. Much lower than ParticleOffset because the Ember is only ~0.57 blocks tall.

WanderRadius.Description: The wander radius of the NPC.

ViewRange.Description: The view distance of the NPC, in blocks.

ViewSector.Description: The view sector of the NPC, in degrees.

HearingRange.Description: The hearing distance of the NPC, in blocks.

AbsoluteDetectionRange.Description: The range at which a target is guaranteed to be detected, in blocks.

AlertedRange.Description: The range within which the target can be seen/sensed when alerted, in blocks.

AlertedActionRange.Description: The range at which the NPC will react, in blocks. Bold: also the range a posturing creature holds its Posture until a stranger leaves.

PostureEnterTime.Description: Bold: seconds the Enter_Posture animation takes (374 frames at 60fps, played at 350% speed = 6.2s / 3.5). Update if the animation length changes.

PostureExitTime.Description: Bold: seconds the Exit_Posture animation takes (374 frames at 60fps, played at 350% speed = 6.2s / 3.5). Update if the animation length changes.

PostureParticleInterval.Description: Bold: seconds between repeats of the posture particle while the posture is held.

LeashDistance.Description: The range at which the NPC starts wanting to return to spawn, in blocks.

WeightFollowItem.Description: Probability the NPC will follow an attractive item, in percent.

FollowItemAlways.Description: Whether the NPC follows an attractive item indefinitely.

FollowItemPreDelay.Description: Time delay before the NPC starts following an item.

FollowItemTimeout.Description: Duration of follow item behaviour before giving up.

FlockArray.Description: The set of NPCs belonging to this flock type.

ClimbHeight.Description: The maximum climb height, in blocks.

AttitudeGroup.Description: The attitude group this NPC belongs to.

PlayerDefaultAttitude.Description: The default attitude towards the player.

AlertedTimeoutGiveUp.Description: Timeout after which an alerted NPC gives up, in seconds.

DayTimePeriod.Description: The hour range considered daytime for this NPC.

DayTimeNapWeight.Description: Weight for daytime nap behavior. 0 to disable.

DayTimeNapTimeRange.Description: Duration range of daytime naps, in seconds.

DayFlavorAnimation.Description: Flavor animation to play during the day.

IgnoreOverrideTime.Description: Duration of the ignore attitude override.

IsMountable.Description: Whether this NPC can be mounted.

IsTameable.Description: Whether this NPC can be tamed.

TameRequiredAttitudes.Description: Attitude groups of players that can tame the NPC.

TameRoleChange.Description: The role the NPC changes into when tamed.

DayFlavorAnimationLength.Description: How long the daytime flavor animation plays, in seconds.

Timid.Description: Whether this NPC is timid. Ember Wyrmling is BOLD (see CreatureTemperamentRegistry): it never flees from players, it postures at strangers instead.

AlertViewRange.Description: Bold: sight range at which Idle detection alerts this creature to a player, in blocks. Much smaller than ViewRange so it settles back into Idle (and wanders) when nobody is close.

AlertHearingRange.Description: Bold: hearing range at which Idle detection alerts this creature to a non-crouching player, in blocks.

WarnRange.Description: Bold: range at which an unowned (Wild) creature postures at a stranger, in blocks.

WarnRangeOwned.Description: Bold: shorter stranger-posture range once the creature has an owner (Tame and above), in blocks.

AttackWhenStartled.Description: Whether this NPC attacks when startled.

Attack.Description: The attack interaction this NPC will use.

AttackRange.Description: The range at which the NPC can identify an attacker.

MaxSpeed.Description: The maximum walking speed of the NPC.

MaxHealth.Description: The maximum health of the NPC.

MaxRotationSpeed.Description: The maximum rotation speed, in degrees per second.

RunThreshold.Description: Speed ratio at which the NPC switches to run animation.

IsMemory.Description: Whether the NPC is a memory.

MemoriesNameOverride.Description: If set, overrides the memory name.

BreathesInWater.Description: Whether this NPC can breathe underwater.

NameTranslationKey.Description: Translation key for the NPC name display.

Interactions.$Comment: Config for a successful melee hit

Instructions.$Comment: This is separate so it can run all the time regardless of the rest of the script
Update flock member leash positions to match the leader.
Join eligible flocks if not a member of a flock.
When in water go straight to panic to get out
Initialize the produce alarm.
Clear the produce alarm when it finishes
Switch to flee state if any flock member engages a target.
Check if there are any potential things that can alert the NPC

Thrown food: any creature (wild or owned) that sees a dropped item from its diet walks over, picks it up into its hotbar, and EatDroppedFood (Java) consumes it - plays Eat, credits bond/cooldown if owned. Alert/flee instructions above take priority.
Tame/Bonded/Devoted: follow any Friendly food-holding player from Idle. Head tracks player; Curious animation plays while following.
If beyond soft leash radius for a set period, return home.
Tame: head tracks the owner when within 8 blocks (slot set by CreatureTierSlotSystem). Continue so other idle behaviors still run.
Bonded: head tracks the owner when within 10 blocks. (Bold has no step-toward-owner behavior; confident-gait/escort positioning needs custom assets, see TODO.md.)
Devoted follow: actively seek the assigned owner. Registered by CreatureLeashTrackingSystem via role.setMarkedTarget.

Regular wander.
Play a daytime flavor animation.
Nap.
Sleep time.
Wake up if an enemy attacks a flock member.
Just a little nap.
Start the nap timer
Night-time sleep.
Alerted state.
Play the alerted animation when entering the state

Actions.$Comment: Initialise the posture-particle timer. An uninitialised timer reads as Stopped on every tick, which made the repeating posture particle spam until the first full posture had run.
Actions.Name: PostureParticleTimer

Instructions.$Comment: Check for damage
Watching a target always, if we have any. MatchLook turns the whole body to follow the head so the creature actually faces the target.
Bond tier advanced while alerted — target is now Friendly, return to Idle immediately.
BOLD posture hold: while postured and the stranger is still within AlertedActionRange, keep the Alerted state alive (restart its give-up timer) so the looping Posture keeps playing.
BOLD posture particles: while the posture is held, repeat the posture particle every PostureParticleInterval seconds.
BOLD posture exit: the stranger left (or has no target any more) - play Exit_Posture, then return to normal. The Alerted timer then runs out and the creature goes back to Idle.
Timer ended, not timid and still have a target, ignore it
Timer ended, timid and still have a non-friendly target, flee
No target, go idle
If enabled, start a timer to give up on chasing a target
If the target is holding a liked item, follow it
After the alerted timeout, make a decision
If a non-friendly target gets too close, flee for a bit (Timid species only; Bold stands its ground)

Sensor.$Comment: If target is reasonably close, the NPC will react

Instructions.$Comment: BOLD stranger warning, owned creature (Tame/Bonded/Devoted): shorter trigger range (WarnRangeOwned). Never flees; stands its ground in a warning posture. Owner is Friendly so never triggers this. Starts the posture: Enter_Posture, then the looping Posture is left playing (held by the 'Posturing' flag; see the hold/exit instructions above) until the stranger leaves.

BOLD stranger warning, unowned/Wild creature: warns at the longer WarnRange. Skipped when the creature has an owner (handled above with the shorter range). Never flees. Same Enter_Posture -> looping Posture sequence as above.
Threatening actions that will cause the NPC to flee (Timid species only; Bold stands its ground)
If the target is holding a liked item, follow it
Switch to flee state if any flock member engages a target.
Check if there are any potential things that can alert the NPC
Bond tier advanced mid-flee — target is now Friendly, return to Idle immediately.
Target is crouching and offering appropriate food — interrupt flee, return to Alerted so the creature can re-evaluate.
